texts.zh:
[Root.Federation.GetName]近来的法律修订引起了不小的骚动，我国与[dispute_winner.GetName]间旧有的意识形态争论重新被推上前台。我国代表，[dispute_loser_envoy.GetName]，就我方立场大胆地与[dispute_winner.GetAdj]行政官[dispute_winner_envoy.GetName]进行了辩论。可是，[dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe]关于军国主义益处的见解并未使其他在场人员信服，辩论逐渐对[dispute_loser_envoy.GetHerHim]变得不利，[dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe]看起来愈发紧张，在场各方都在向[dispute_loser_envoy.GetHerHim]指责“[Root.GetAdj]穷兵黩武”。

[Root.GetGovernmentName]各处的公民饶有兴致地观看了整场辩论，并对如何将自己的理想与[Root.Federation.GetName]的成员国资格相调和愈发担忧。
texts.en:
The recent law changes in the [Root.Federation.GetName] caused a significant stir, with old ideological debates between ourselves and the [dispute_winner.GetName] once again rising to the fore. Our representative, [dispute_loser_envoy.GetName], bravely represented our side of the debate against the [dispute_winner.GetAdj] official, [dispute_winner_envoy.GetName]. However, [dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe] [dispute_loser_envoy.GetWasWere] unable to convince those present of the benefits of a more militaristic outlook, and as the debate turned against [dispute_loser_envoy.GetHerHim], [dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe] appeared increasingly rattled as accusations of "[Root.GetAdj] warmongering" were made against [dispute_loser_envoy.GetHerHim] from all sides.

Citizens across the [Root.GetGovernmentName] watched the debate with interest, and are increasingly concerned about how to reconcile their ideals with membership in the [Root.Federation.GetName].

[Root.GetGovernmentName]各处的公民饶有兴致地观看了整场辩论，并对如何将自己的理想与[Root.Federation.GetName]的成员国资格相调和愈发担忧。
texts.en:
The recent law changes in the [Root.Federation.GetName] caused a significant stir, with old ideological debates between ourselves and the [dispute_winner.GetName] once again rising to the fore. Our representative, [dispute_loser_envoy.GetName], bravely represented our side of the debate against the [dispute_winner.GetAdj] official, [dispute_winner_envoy.GetName]. However, [dispute_loser_envoy.GetSheHe] [dispute_loser_envoy.GetWasWere] unable to convince those present of the benefits of a more pacifistic outlook, and faced vociferous retorts from all quarters that "[Root.GetAdj] naivety" allegedly threatens the safety of the entire federation.

Citizens across the [Root.GetGovernmentName] watched the debate with interest, and are increasingly concerned about how to reconcile their ideals with membership in the [Root.Federation.GetName].

texts.zh: [Root.Federation.GetName]近来的法律修订引起了不小的骚动，我国与[dispute_loser.GetName]间旧有的意识形态争论重新被推上前台。我国代表，[dispute_winner_envoy.GetName]设法说服大多数人接受了军国主义更有好处的见解，强调[dispute_loser.GetAdj]特使，[dispute_loser_envoy.GetName]的信条本质上懦弱而幼稚。可是，[dispute_loser.GetSpeciesNamePlural]对这件事大为不满，抱怨其侵犯了他们的价值观念，并对联邦前进的方向表示担忧。
texts.en: The recent law changes in the [Root.Federation.GetName] caused a significant stir, with old ideological debates between ourselves and the [dispute_loser.GetName] once again rising to the fore. Our representative, [dispute_winner_envoy.GetName], was able to persuade many of the benefits of a more militaristic outlook, highlighting the cowardice and naivety inherent in the beliefs of the [dispute_loser.GetAdj] envoy, [dispute_loser_envoy.GetName]. However, the [dispute_loser.GetSpeciesNamePlural] took this turn of events poorly, complaining at the encroachment on their values and expressing concern at the direction the federation is currently taking.

texts.zh: [Root.Federation.GetName]近来的法律修订引起了不小的骚动，我国与[dispute_loser.GetName]间旧有的意识形态争论重新被推上前台。我国代表，[dispute_winner_envoy.GetName]设法说服大多数人接受了和平主义更有好处的见解，展示出[dispute_loser.GetAdj]穷兵黩武给我们所有人都带来了危险。幸好，[dispute_loser.GetSpeciesNamePlural]对此坦然相对，愿意为盟友伙伴的和谐关系所带来的好处而妥协。
texts.en: The recent law changes in the [Root.Federation.GetName] caused a significant stir, with old ideological debates between ourselves and the [dispute_loser.GetName] once again rising to the fore. Our representative, [dispute_winner_envoy.GetName], was able to persuade many of the benefits of a more pacifistic outlook, demonstrating the dangers caused to us all by [dispute_loser.GetAdj] warmongering. Fortunately, the [dispute_loser.GetSpeciesNamePlural] took this in good grace, recognizing the need for compromise in the interest of a more harmonious relationship with their alliance partners.
